title: Read phone photos and scans (OCR with Gemini 3 Flash)
goal: Turn on OCR: a photographed or scanned case file is read with Gemini 3 Flash through the AI Gateway, instead of 'No text could be read' (user, 2026-11-16, after the OCR comparison in docs/APP.md).
for_whom: A practising lawyer who uploads court papers as phone photos or scanned PDFs, in English, Sinhala or Tamil.

done_check.check: A phone photo (JPEG) of a plaint in each of English, Sinhala and Tamil, uploaded on New case, is read: character error rate 1% or less against the known text, and the case's first brief uses its facts (party, amount, date).
A multi-page scanned PDF with no text layer is read page by page (page n's text is page n); in a PDF with some text-layer pages, those pages keep their own text and only the others are read by OCR.

Every OCR call is one usage row (kind ocr, the Gemini model, the gateway's billed cost, pages counted) and counts toward the workspace spend limit; a workspace over its limit gets no OCR call and the file says why.
A file whose text came from OCR shows a small 'Read from a scan' note (check names, dates and amounts against the original) where the lawyer reads the file; files with their own text do not.
The cost per page measured on the test photos is recorded in docs/APP.md (expected about $0.004-0.009 a page).

scenarios.steps: A lawyer photographs a Sinhala plaint on a phone and starts a New case with it.
scenarios.expect: The file reads; the first brief names the parties and the sum claimed as the plaint has them; the file carries the 'Read from a scan' note.

scenarios.steps: A lawyer adds a 20-page scanned journal (PDF, no text layer) to a case and asks what happened on a date in it.
scenarios.expect: The answer cites the right page of the journal.

scenarios.steps: A workspace at its spend limit uploads a photo.
scenarios.expect: No OCR call is made; the file says the spend limit stopped it.

out_of_scope: Re-reading files uploaded before OCR was on (user: new uploads only).
A per-file page cap (user: the spend limit covers it).
Other OCR providers (Mistral OCR, Document AI, DeepSeek-OCR) and a fallback between them.
The chat agent warning when a quoted fact came from a scanned page.

decisions.note: Gemini 3 Flash via the AI Gateway: the only model of 16 tried that read Sinhala and Tamil photos well (docs/APP.md OCR test); metered like every model call (user).
OCR'd files show a 'Read from a scan' note, because on hard photos every model tried put plausible wrong words (names, dates) (user).

progress.note: Scoped with the user and agreed; summary on issue #54; branch app/ocr-gemini off origin/main; Neon branch agent/ocr-gemini, .env.local points at it (.env.main kept).

Validation round 1 on 70f2119: semantic PASS; security FAIL (high: spend limits summed kind 'llm' only, so OCR spend was never counted; medium: a long scan could run past the limit after the upload check; medium: every page's images decoded before the first call; low: .env.example stale). Fixed in the same commit (now one commit): limits and admin spend queries count kind in ('llm','ocr') (agent branch: the test user's spend today 0.0333 -> 0.0659 with the 24 OCR pages); extract checks the owner's spend (Deps.budget -> checkSpend) before every 16 scanned pages and stops, not retried, saying 'Stopped after N of M scanned pages' (unit test); page images decoded one page at a time (pdfPageImages().page(n), closed at the end); .env.example says OCR is on by default and lists MODEL_OCR. Platform admins are not exempt from the mid-scan check (no user row in the pipeline). The d3 walk's tiny limit had been passed by llm spend, so it had not shown OCR counted.

Round 2 on 3a23d46: semantic PASS, security PASS (lows left: one huge single-page image decoded whole; unscoped calls meter to 'unknown'; Mistral/OCR_URL have no mid-file check). PR #70 rebase-merged at 12:32 UTC; no schema change, so no production migration. Neon branch agent/ocr-gemini deleted; .env.local back on production. OCR is on in production with the deploy (default provider, no env var needed).
